# Hempston Home

> Hempston Home designs and builds custom kitchen cabinets, vanities and built-ins in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and installs across Canada and the US.

Hempston Home is a custom cabinet maker founded in 2015. Every commission is designed and built to the room. Signature work includes painted Shaker and inset face-frame kitchens, white oak and walnut millwork, butler's pantries, wet bars, custom vanities, mudrooms, laundry rooms, and built-ins.

## Key facts

- Business: Hempston Home, custom cabinet maker, founded 2015
- Built in Canada. Cabinets are built in Halifax, Nova Scotia at our Bayne St shop, 6359 Bayne St, Halifax, NS B3K 2V6. Toronto and the Long Beach area facility are studios and service bases, not manufacturing sites.
- Halifax studio (main): 6359 Bayne St, Halifax, NS B3K 2V6, Canada
- Toronto studio: 116B Galaxy Blvd, Toronto (Etobicoke), ON M9W 4Y6, Canada
- Long Beach area facility: 3460 Cherry Ave, Lakewood, CA 90712, USA (serves Long Beach and Southern California)
- Phone: (902) 719-8497 | Email: info@hempstonhome.com | Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, by appointment
- Service area: we install across Canada and the United States, including Halifax and Nova Scotia, Atlantic Canada, Toronto and the GTA, and the Long Beach area
- Typical full custom kitchen: CAD $25,000 to $75,000. Vanities and built-ins usually start between $4,000 and $12,000
- Lead time: 8 to 14 weeks from first consultation to install. Rush is a separate program, about 6 weeks for qualifying projects, with the rush premium quoted up front
- Warranty: 5-year workmanship warranty on cabinetry. Manufacturer warranties on hardware and finishes are passed along in the project agreement
- Consultation: free. We reply within one business day
